about_the_game:
Rise. Fight. Conquer.

In Last Wave, you step into the shoes of Ren who is trapped in an unforgiving world where survival is the only goal. Face relentless waves of enemies, each round pushing your skills to the limit. Strategically combine melee combat, magic, and powerful techniques to outlast the ever-growing threat.

Wave-Based Combat – Battle against increasingly difficult enemies. Stay sharp, adapt your strategy, and prepare for the next round.

Master Your Weapon – Choose between the swift and deadly sword or the versatile and mystical staff. Each weapon has its own specialties, techniques, and playstyle. Will you strike with precision or unleash powerful elemental magic?

Elemental Abilities & Techniques – Unlock and wield fire, ice, and lightning magic to devastate enemies. Combine these powers with melee attacks for explosive combos.

Immersive World – Fight through hostile environments filled with deadly creatures, each with their own behaviors and attack patterns.

Do you have what it takes to survive?

We’re not done yet. Last Wave will continue to grow with future updates. Expect new gameplay mechanics, weapons, and environments to test your survival skills.
